home.title: Bench
home.lede: Four apps, one server, one machine. Your data lives in SQLite files on this disk and goes nowhere else.
home.crm.tagline: Deals, and the people behind them
home.crm.detail: Organizations, contacts and a drag-and-drop pipeline, with a dashboard that adds up what is actually in play.
home.space.tagline: Everything you know, in one place
home.space.detail: Pages and blocks that nest as deep as you like, databases with table, board and list views, and search across the lot.
home.rolodex.tagline: The people in your life, kept close
home.rolodex.detail: Who you are due to contact, what is going on with them, birthdays coming up, and a timeline of every conversation.
home.groove.detail: Four synth units, one transport and a master DJ filter. Pure Web Audio — no samples, no plugins, no latency budget.
drag.instructions: To pick up an item, press Space or Enter. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space or Enter again to drop it, and Escape to cancel.
